title: WA Recovery Pro v2.0.2 — Live Voice Pitch Effects, Photo Sync & True Image Sharing
changelog: 🔊 Universal Voice Playback: Voice messages now seamlessly play from both Messages tab and Voice tab
⚡ Real-Time Pitch Effects: Chipmunk, Deep Voice & Robot effects applied to hardware speaker via Android PlaybackParams
🛡️ Zero Voice Duplication: Strict ID & file path deduplication prevents duplicate 'Voice Note' entries in IndexedDB
🖼️ Proactive Photo Recovery: Enhanced notification image extraction and instant media scanner sync to Photos tab
📤 True Image Sharing: Base64 photos decode into native cache files for direct, lossless image sharing to WhatsApp
